title: Bring / brought / brought
descriptionFa: فرق bring (آوردن به اینجا) و take (بردن به اونجا)، و bring back.

words.example: Come to my house tomorrow and bring your guitar.
words.tipFa: bring مثل come هست: از اونجا به اینجا. برای کسی آوردن: bring me a glass of water.

words.example: Please take these papers to the secretary.
words.tipFa: take مثل go هست: از اینجا به اونجا.

words.example: My aunt brought us some sweets from Yazd.
words.tipFa: bring / brought / brought. تلفظ: «بروت»، gh خونده نمی‌شه.

words.example: Please bring back my umbrella tomorrow.
words.tipFa: با ضمیر وسطش: bring it back.
